objective: G18 with G17. status: Computed, referee pending; all five predictions held, P1 partly on a sample. Seven stalled starts with a distinction held three times, each hidden at exactly 2, gain one through a birth that took a shared distinction (smallest: 10 knots, 127/63). One added not-all-equal knot with a fresh distinction lifts 27 of the 12,073 two-holder starts (27 of the 51 hidden at exactly 2); every such knot takes one loose distinction and one to three shared ones, none takes loose distinctions only (0 of 2.05 million), and neither rule makes any of them at round 1.
title: Does a birth that takes a shared distinction let growth finish a structure with a hidden excess?
